payload.title: Lab is the single classifier per publication
payload.description:
Decision (Ryan, 2026-10-22): the central Cyclotron lab is THE classifier per publication. Hosted URL reading = option B: a front Lambda with Function URL (AWS_IAM) plus one Fargate task per job (arm64, 2 vCPU / 8 GB, GROBID 0.9.1-crf sidecar), a DynamoDB jobs table, per-job cap of 7 requests / $0.50, a daily job cap, an AWS Budget of $25/mo, and the OpenAI key in SSM SecureString /cyclotron/transformer/openai-api-key. Deployed in account 682849160744 as the separate stack cyclotron-transformer. Lab criteria are rewritten from each publication's approved doctrine and approved by Ryan.

Related epics: decision-flywheel-a73f05cc (Embeddable cyclotron: Papyrus integration; an epic cannot be a child of an epic, so linked here) and decision-flywheel-1da33407 (Hosted curation upstream; its earlier C1-C7, I1-I5, P1 children are a different set). Papyrus-side tickets are on the PPY board; Prospectus R1/R2 are filed by the Prospectus session.

Suggested order: 1 P4a, C5, C6, C4; 2 lab criteria sign-off; 3 C1 and P1 (with fakes); 4 I7, I6, I9 (approval); 5 I8 and lab deploy (approval); 6 P2, P3, S1 verify; 7 R1/R2 then S2, S3; 8 C3 then P5, P4b, P6.

Approved by Ryan 2026-10-22; AWS changes need his explicit approval.
